# Winter Clothing Canada — full product list

Winter Clothing Canada is an independent guide to winter clothing for real Canadian cold, focused on Mountain Warehouse and Columbia. It sells nothing. Retailer links go to the retailers' own pages. No affiliate links are active yet; when added, they will be clearly marked. Updated November 5, 2026. Product pictures are created images of similar products, not the actual product photos.

Price tracker: all 50 prices below were checked live on the retailer's own site on November 5, 2026, and are re-checked daily. 28 of 50 are on sale. Biggest saving: Mountain Warehouse Antarctic Extreme, 63% off ($199.99, was $539.99, $340 off). Each product on the page shows the date its price was last checked and the lowest price we have seen. Prices change — the retailer's page is the final word.
